1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Perihal Dagangan
(Penandaan Barang Ganti Pelapik Brek) 2013.

  (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 November 2014.

Ketidakpakaian

2. Perintah ini tidak terpakai bagi—

(a) barang ganti pelapik brek  asli yang mempunyai nama dagangan atau cap
dagangan pengilang , dan kod pengenalan , yang sama dengan nama
dagangan atau cap dagangan pengilang, dan kod pengenalan , bagi pelapik
brek yang dipasang pada kenderaan  semasa pembuatan kenderaan itu ;
dan

(b) barang ganti pelapik brek yang digunakan bagi sampel pengujian.

Penandaan barang ganti pelapik brek

3. (1) Barang ganti pelapik brek  yang dibekalkan atau ditawarkan untuk
dibekalkan hendaklah mempunyai tanda  yang dinyatakan dalam ruang ( 1) Jadual
mengikut standard yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2) Jadual, mengikut mana -mana yang
berkenaan.

 (2) Dalam Perintah ini, "barang ganti pelapik brek" ertinya barang ganti
pelapik brek yang mematuhi—

(a) Standard Malaysia MS 1164  atau peraturan 90 Suruhanjaya
Ekonomi Bangsa-Bangsa Bersatu bagi Eropah; dan

(b) kehendak spesifikasi di bawah kaedah 15  Kaedah-Kaedah
Kenderaan Bermotor (Pembinaan dan Penggunaan) 1959
[L.N. 170/1959].

TRADE DESCRIPTIONS ACT 2011

TRADE DESCRIPTIONS (MARKING OF REPLACEMENT PART OF BRAKE LINING)
ORDER 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 29 (1)(b) of the Trade Descriptions
Act 2011 [Act 730], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) This order may be cited as the Trade Descriptions (Marking of
Replacement Part of Brake Lining) Order 2013.

  (2) This Order comes into operation on 1 November 2014.

Non-application
2. This Order shall not apply to—

(a) an original  replacement part of  brake lining which bears the
manufacturer's trade name or trade mark , and identification code , which
are similar to  the manufacturer's trade name or trade mark, and
identification code, of the brake lining installed on the  vehicle at the time
of manufacturing of such vehicle; and

(b) a replacement part of brake lining used for test sampling.

Marking of replacement part of brake lining
3. (1) A replacement part of brake lining  supplied or offered for supply shall
bear the mark specified in column (1) of the Schedule  according to  the standard
specified in column (2) of the Schedule, as the case may be.

(2) In this Order, "replacement part of brake lining" means a replacement
part of brake lining which complies with—

(a) the Malaysian Standard MS 1164  or regulation 90 of the United
Nations Economic Commission for Europe; and

(b) the specification requirements under rule 15 of  the Motor Vehicles
(Construction and Use) Rules 1959 [L.N. 170/1959].
